title: Strict binary64 array regions
objective: Extend the ordered IEEE-754 optimizer with reviewed sequence-fed loops and reductions, preserving source rounding, NaN, signed-zero, infinity, exception, alias, and fallback semantics; add isolated pass/target/verifier/emitter files, differential tests, and cross-runtime benchmarks; do not edit central catalogs or dispatchers.

handoff.summary: Implemented an explicit-contract-only O2 strict binary64 immutable-tuple reduction plugin with isolated domain recognition, representation and V8 target plans, a transformation-independent verifier, and a transactional source-ordered emitter. The route streams authenticated tuple elements without copying or boundaries, keeps Number state private until success, restarts the untouched loop on a late guard failure, preserves zero-trip input/target identity, and emits one rounding point per retained operation without reassociation, contraction, or fast math. Added adversarial O0/CPython bit-pattern and fallback tests plus cold/warm compile and same-checksum CPython/NumPy/Numba/Julia benchmark reporting. No central catalog, lowering registry, verifier catalog, dispatcher, bootstrap, package-script, or architecture expectation was edited.
risks: The integration-owned registrations are intentionally absent, so three emitted O2 tests remain explicitly skipped and the benchmark makes no Sage.js O2 runtime claim until registration lands.

Two recorded integration attempts passed batches 1 and 2, then stopped in batch 3 on the unrelated wall-clock assertion in test/dense-prime-host-boundary.cjs: GF(2) scalar write took 51.72us and 52.54us against a 50us ceiling. The focused test passed immediately when run alone; the lane has no registered runtime path and does not touch dense-prime files.
Direct validation was performed on linux-x64; linux-arm64, windows-x64, and macos-arm64 remain CI responsibilities.
next_steps: Register strictFloatArrayPlugin at priority 250, the v8.strict-float-array-loop.v1 lowering contract, strictFloatArrayVerifierPlugin, and print_strict_float_array_region in the integration-owned catalogs and dispatcher.
Export ./domains/strict-binary64-array from the optimizer index, update optimizer architecture expectations, and optionally add a bench:optimizer-strict-float-array package script.

After registration, rerun test/optimizer-strict-float-array.cjs and bench/optimizer-strict-float-array/benchmark.cjs --check so the three O2 tests execute and the benchmark records the emitted route; rerun the integration tier on an uncontented host to clear the inherited timing threshold.
